target_text:
"Mom what time is it", said my brother

"it's 7:30pm and

you better get all that homework done because you still have to do your chores" my mom said in a calmly voice. My mom is always telling me

to do my homework but she doesn't get that I have a lot of stress. Because of how the school board added a extra hour and a half to school and I still have basketball practice. And I don't get home until 7:30 and when I get home I still have to do my homework, take a shower and do my chores around the house. The school board shouldn't add a hour and a half to school because after school activities would be longer, students wouldn't have that much time for homework and it would be more stress on students.

Firstly the school board shouldn't add a hour and a half to school because after school activities would be longer. If after school activities have to be longer because of the school board adding a hour and a half to the school time. That means that less people are going to do after school activities. Because some people don't have a ride or their parents work until late. Or some just don't want to do because they are going to get home late.

Also the school board shouldn't add a hour and a half to school because students wouldn't have that much time to do homework. Some students do after school activities and some have to go home and babysit there brothers and sisters. For example me I have to go home most of the time to babysit my brothers. And my parents don't

get off work until late at night so don't get anytime to do my homework.But when I do have time to do it when my brothers fall asleep I do it because it is important.

Finally the school board shouldn't add a hour and a half to school because it would be more stress on students. Adding more time to school it can be more stressful because school is already stressful. All the work we got to do and homework and projects.Do you ever

get stress out because of school?

The school board should not add a hour and a half to school time because it is to much. What do you do after school?

Go home and write a letter to the school board and tell them how you feel about them adding a hour and a half to school.
